exact_interface.witness: f_C(B_C), total as syntax but semantically required only on D_C
exact_interface.domain_contract: pi_D certifies D_C(B) iff exists X_C F_C(X_C,B)
exact_interface.outside_domain: No witness correctness obligation when D_C(B)=FALSE.

inherited_rule_forms: GUARDED_ITE(guard, rule_true, rule_false) with hash-consed sharing
inherited_justifications: LOCAL_GUARD_PARTITION whose two guards are exact complements and whose child derivations are independently valid

exactly_one_new_positive_rule.name: INTERNAL_COVER_WITNESS(alpha)
exactly_one_new_positive_rule.tautology_safe_cover: U_C_star = AND_{D: B(D) not identically TRUE} I(D)
exactly_one_new_positive_rule.checker_contract: For every local clause D, verify either B(D) is syntactically/exactly tautological under normalized literal representation or alpha satisfies an internal literal of D.
exactly_one_new_positive_rule.conclusion: F_C(alpha,B) is identically TRUE; therefore D_C=TRUE and f_C(B)=alpha is a valid constant Skolem witness.
exactly_one_new_positive_rule.synthesis_claim: NONE. Finding alpha is not assumed polynomial.

guarded_composition.coverage_rule: Coverage is by construction from exact complementary branches g and NOT g; no generic tautology proof for a guard union is permitted.
guarded_composition.composed_domain: D = (g AND D_true) OR ((NOT g) AND D_false)
guarded_composition.composed_witness_proof: Check both child witness proofs under their child domains and the exact complementary guard partition.

UNIVERSAL_BRANCH_SHIELDING.condition: D_C=TRUE and f_C is constant alpha certified by INTERNAL_COVER_WITNESS

DISTRIBUTED_SHIELDING.condition: D_C=TRUE, no constant universal branch, and a nonconstant proof-carrying guarded witness covers all boundary inputs

SEMANTIC_SIGNAL.condition: D_C is neither TRUE nor FALSE
SEMANTIC_SIGNAL.obligation: Retain exact D_C in the interface; do not relabel the object as failed Skolem synthesis merely because the domain is partial.

TRIVIAL_FALSE.witness_obligation: vacuous; exact domain proof still required

proof_carrying_cost_metrics.PCShieldSize: Minimum accepted proof-DAG size among certificates with D_C=TRUE; undefined/infinite when D_C is not TRUE.
proof_carrying_cost_metrics.polynomial_success_requires: One fixed polynomial in original input length L simultaneously bounding synthesis time, proof size, and verification time.

hostile_suite.bridge_attack_question: Can the frozen V1.1 calculus synthesize polynomial-size shared guarded witness/domain proofs for total or partial interfaces without invoking generic coNP-hard validity and without expanding an exponential decision tree?
hostile_suite.explicit_distributed_scaling_question: For relations with U_C_star UNSAT but D_C=TRUE, is there a uniformly synthesized polynomial-size hash-consed GUARDED_ITE proof DAG, with polynomial local verification, or does proof/synthesis size become superpolynomial?
hostile_suite.semantic_signal_question: When D_C is nontrivial, can an exact polynomial-size proof-carrying domain plus conditional witness be synthesized and verified, rather than silently totalizing or dropping the domain?
